data.title: How crowdshipping works
data.description: Whether you're sending a gift or filling spare luggage weight — three steps to done.

steps.title: Find or post a journey
steps.description: Travelers list upcoming flights with available kilograms. Senders search by route and date.

steps.title: Match & lock escrow
steps.description: Agree on price, pay into escrow, and chat to arrange pickup before departure.

steps.title: Deliver & get paid
steps.description: Traveler carries the item, uploads proof at arrival, and funds release automatically.

data.title: Built for trust at every mile
data.description: From pickup photo to release of escrow — every step is logged, notified, and dispute-ready.

items.title: Escrow payments
items.description: Funds are held until the recipient confirms delivery. Travelers get paid, senders stay protected.

items.title: Verified identities
items.description: Government ID and selfie checks for travelers. Reputation scores follow every completed trip.

items.title: Real-time chat
items.description: Coordinate pickup windows and customs details in a dedicated thread per delivery.

items.title: Global corridors
items.description: Browse journeys by origin, destination, and available weight — match in minutes.

items.title: Photo proof
items.description: Pickup and drop-off photos timestamped and attached to the delivery timeline.

items.title: Fair disputes
items.description: Structured resolution when something goes wrong, with admin review and audit trail.

data.title: Ready to try it?
data.description: Browse open journeys or list your next trip — it takes under two minutes.
